policy: Prefer original synthetic scenarios. No substantial source text, rules, code or datasets are copied. For US government works, verify item-level third-party notices. For ATT&CK, retain attribution and comply with trademark/terms. For Sigma, distinguish public-domain specification from DRL-licensed repository rules. For OWASP, CC-BY-SA-4.0 applies to relevant documentation; verify share-alike implications before redistributing adapted text.

nist.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
nist.license: U.S. Government work; generally public domain in the United States; verify third-party material and individual publication notices
nist.usage: Original scenario and explanation; no text copied

cisa.name: CISA Cybersecurity Guidance
cisa.license: U.S. Government work generally public domain in the United States, subject to third-party exceptions and page-specific notices
cisa.usage: Original scenario and explanation; no text copied

mitre.name: MITRE ATT&CK
mitre.license: MITRE ATT&CK Terms of Use; royalty-free use for research, development and commercial purposes subject to attribution and trademark rules; not assumed to be CC BY 4.0
mitre.usage: Technique concepts only; no ATT&CK text or data reproduced

sigma.name: Sigma Specification
sigma.license: Specification is public domain per SigmaHQ repository license; third-party rule content is separately licensed under DRL 1.1 and is not copied
sigma.usage: Original detection logic examples; no SigmaHQ rule text copied

owasp.name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
owasp.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0; examples in this dataset are original paraphrased scenarios, not copied text; verify share-alike implications before distributing adaptations
owasp.usage: Original scenarios informed by security principles; no text copied

original.name: LFM3-Cyber original synthetic scenario design
original.license: Original project-authored content; no external text reproduced
original.usage: Synthetic example authored for this dataset

splunk_attack_data.name: Splunk Attack Data
splunk_attack_data.license: Apache License 2.0 at repository root; individual data files may be Git LFS; verify file-level provenance and notices before redistribution
splunk_attack_data.usage: Dataset catalog metadata inspected; no raw event logs or Git LFS payloads copied

otrf_security_datasets.name: OTRF Security Datasets
otrf_security_datasets.license: LICENSE file states MIT while README states GPL-3.0 and points to a legacy repository
otrf_security_datasets.usage: Excluded; no dataset content used pending license clarification

cic_ids.name: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity — CIC-IDS2017
cic_ids.license: Dataset is publicly available for research and requires citation of the associated paper; no broad permissive redistribution license is assumed; no dataset rows or PCAPs copied
cic_ids.usage: Dataset description only informed an original evaluation scenario; no dataset files copied
